scope: Proposition 10.1 (The varying rank-four case) of the manuscript “Projective-space bases of Lagrangian fibrations” (preprints/Projective-Space-Bases-of-Lagrangian-Fibrations-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 041 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5fdf543649f1469a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 78. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a projective irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifold of dimension 2n with b2(X) = 4, and let f : X −→ B, g : X −→ C be projective Lagrangian fibrations with normal projective bases. Assume that the polarized family of smooth fibers of g has nonzero variation and that, for every smooth fiber At of g, the restriction f|At : At → B is finite and surjective. Fix a connected minimum stratum S0 ⊂ B and its smooth Deligne–Mumford stack S as in Propositions 4.3 and 4.5. Then Ha,b (S) = 0 for a ̸= b, χtop(S0) = X p hp,p (S) > 0.
